data.name: Fused Zamasu
data.description:
The fusion heavily resembles Future Zamasu, yet supplemented with various traits of Goku Black, including Goku Black's height and build. She possesses Future Zamasu's green skin, gray irises, and white hair; however, her face has more of Goku Black's jawline. She has Future Zamasu's eye shape, but with dark lines under the bottom eyelids and somewhat smaller ears. The fusion's hairstyle looks mostly like Goku Black's as Super Saiyan Rosé (Fused Zamasu herself is in the Super Saiyan Rosé form in all of her appearances in all Dragon Ball media, with the exception of his Infinite Zamasu form in the Dragon Ball Super anime), but with a long protruding bang over the right side of her face, representing Zamasu's mohawk.

She wears the original present Gowasu's green Potara earrings on both ears and Supreme Kai's clothing that is nearly identical to Future Zamasu's, but with Goku Black's color-scheme, undershirt and red sash. She also wears a Time Ring (in the anime only) on her right index finger.

With her fused body being an unbalanced mix, while her semi-immortal body struggles to properly heal from damage, her body's damaged sections mutate into a purple and slimy substance, which happened to the entire right half of her body. It also caused the sclera of her right eye to turn yellow and her pupil to turn purplish red. When Fused Zamasu used Light of Divine Justice, it caused her right arm to grow massive.

Retaining the arrogance and self-entitlement of Goku Black and Future Zamasu, this fusion believes herself to be the embodiment of justice. Reveling in her power, Zamasu openly declared herself the supreme god upon her emergence, repeatedly and consistently vocalizing her divine brilliance and absolute authority. Her ego is displayed by how she refuses to even defend herself against Goku and Vegeta (which continues to some extent until Goku blasts off half of her face during a beam struggle), her tendency to hover high over the battlefield to "look down" on everyone both figuratively and literally, and his use of "divine" terms (such as "holy", "judgement", and "absolution") to name his special techniques.

However, beneath her calm exterior, Fused Zamasu is just as unstable as her components, if not more so; according to Gowasu, this is the result of Zamasu's obsession and hatred with the contradiction between gods and mortals.
